note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are described, and the worker is dimorphic; one alate measurement in the original, carrying a sex symbol, has an unclear meaning and is omitted; synonymy citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown, fontanelle region slightly paler; nasus dark brown with reddish tinge; antennae, legs and body light brown. Head with a few long setae, minute hairs rather sparse; pronotum with several minute hairs; each abdominal tergite with one long seta on each side and a pair at the middle, densely covered with minute hairs elsewhere; sternites with a few long setae and numerous short hairs. Body length 3.00–4.50 mm. Head capsule pyriform (1.45–1.70 mm long including nasus, 0.83–1.00 mm long excluding nasus, 0.73–0.90 mm maximum width); in lateral view incurved, nasus swelling conspicuous. Nasus long, slender, cylindrical and narrow (0.55–0.80 mm long, nasus length/head length index 0.58–0.74); tip with a tuft of hairs. Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial; each with a short spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.15–0.20 mm long, 0.45–0.50 mm wide); anterior margin rounded, slightly concave at the middle; posterior margin convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule brown; antennae, labrum and legs pale yellow; postclypeus light brown; abdomen cream yellow. Head and body densely hairy. Body length 3.00–4.90 mm. Head capsule subcircular (0.97–1.00 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.07–1.10 mm maximum width); coronal suture distinct. Fontanelle plate slightly long, translucent. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 very small, shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; less than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior margin distinctly notched, posterior margin convex (0.50–0.60 mm wide). Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller. Body length 3.00–3.90 mm, 0.80–0.83 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.83–0.90 mm maximum head width, pronotum 0.45–0.58 mm wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown; antennae, labrum, postclypeus and thorax yellowish brown; abdominal tergites dark brown; sternites light brown at the middle, slightly darker laterally, remainder of abdomen nearly white. Head capsule, pronotum, wing scales, abdominal tergites and sternites densely hairy. Body length 16.00–17.50 mm with wings, 6.70–8.80 mm without wings. Head capsule subcircular (1.08–1.18 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.30–1.47 mm wide including compound eyes). Fontanelle plate nearly white, narrow and long, 0.10–0.13 mm long. Compound eyes large, broadly elliptical (0.43–0.50 mm maximum diameter, 0.40 mm minimum diameter). Ocelli elliptical, translucent, very close to the compound eyes (0.15–0.19 mm long, 0.13–0.15 mm wide, compound eye–ocellus distance 0.03–0.05 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 subequal to segment 2 or slightly longer, segment 4 subequal to segment 5. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; about 1/3 as long as wide (0.20–0.21 mm long, 0.57–0.58 mm wide). Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (0.65–0.80 mm long, 1.18–1.40 mm wide); anterior margin straight, without notch; posterior margin weakly notched.
